from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return

            bar = data[symbol]
            if bar is None:
                return

            bars[ticker] = bar

        for ticker, bar in bars.items():
            if ticker == "SPY":
                self.spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
            elif ticker == "AAPL":
                self.aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        aapl_rsi_value = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
        aapl_rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        spy_cross_below = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
            and bars["SPY"].Close < spy_sma_value
        )

        spy_cross_above = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
            and bars["SPY"].Close > spy_sma_value
        )

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if bars["AAPL"].Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        aapl_sell_reason = (
            aapl_rsi_ready
            and aapl_rsi_value > 60
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_cross_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_cross_above:
            price = bars["SPY"].Close
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / price)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
            price = bars["AAPL"].Close
            investment = 20000

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= investment:
                quantity = int(investment / price)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.spy_previous_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        self.spy_previous_sma = spy_sma_value if spy_sma_ready else None
        self.aapl_previous_close = bars["AAPL"].Close
